# Text Editor React (@erag/text-editor-react)

> A modern dependency-free React rich text editor (WYSIWYG) built with native browser APIs. Supports React 18 and 19, TypeScript, mentions (@), merge tags ({{), templates, image uploads, tables, HTML editing, and customizable toolbars.

## Core Information
- **Package**: `@erag/text-editor-react`
- **Documentation**: https://erag.in/text-editor-react/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/the-erag/text-editor-react
- **Issues**: https://github.com/the-erag/text-editor-react/issues
- **NPM Package**: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@erag/text-editor-react
- **Author**: Er Amit Gupta (https://erag.in/)
- **License**: MIT
- **Peer Dependencies**: `react` (>=18.0.0 <20), `react-dom` (>=18.0.0 <20)
- **Runtime Dependencies**: none
- **Keywords**: react, react-editor, wysiwyg, rich-text-editor, editor, contenteditable, mentions, merge-tags, html-editor, nextjs, vite

## Quick Installation
```bash
npm install @erag/text-editor-react
# or
pnpm add @erag/text-editor-react
# or
yarn add @erag/text-editor-react
```

Import the stylesheet once (entry file, root layout, or the component that renders the editor):

```ts
import '@erag/text-editor-react/style.css';
```

---

## Quick Start (React Component)

```tsx
import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Editor, type EditorInit, type EditorInstance } from '@erag/text-editor-react';
import '@erag/text-editor-react/style.css';

const editorConfig: EditorInit = {
    height: 400,
    menubar: true,
    toolbar:
        'undo redo | blocks | bold italic underline | alignment | bullist numlist | link image table | code',
    placeholder: 'Start typing your document...',
};

export default function App() {
    const [content, setContent] = useState('<p>Hello from <strong>Text Editor React</strong>!</p>');
    const editor = useRef<EditorInstance>(null);

    return (
        <div className="editor-wrapper">
            <Editor ref={editor} value={content} onChange={setContent} init={editorConfig} />
            <button type="button" onClick={() => editor.current?.insertHtml('<p>Inserted</p>')}>
                Insert paragraph
            </button>
        </div>
    );
}
```

- Next.js App Router: add `'use client'` at the top of the component file that renders `<Editor />`. The editor is SSR-safe during initialization.
- Inertia.js (React): use `useForm` from `@inertiajs/react` and bind `value={data.content}` / `onChange={(value) => setData('content', value)}`.

### Mentions (@), Merge Tags ({{) & Templates Configuration
```ts
import type { EditorInit } from '@erag/text-editor-react';

const editorConfig: EditorInit = {
    mentions: {
        minimumCharacters: 1,
        debounce: 200,
        limit: 8,
        items: [
            { id: 1, label: 'Amit Gupta', description: 'amit@erag.in' },
            { id: 2, label: 'Developer Team', description: 'dev@erag.in' },
        ],
        // or async: items: async (query, signal) => fetchUsers(query, signal),
    },
    mergeTags: {
        items: [
            { value: '{{user.name}}', name: 'User Full Name', group: 'User' },
            { value: '{{user.email}}', name: 'User Email Address', group: 'User' },
            { value: '{{company.name}}', name: 'Company Name', group: 'Company' },
        ],
    },
    templates: {
        items: [
            {
                id: 'welcome',
                label: 'Welcome Email',
                description: 'Standard onboarding greeting',
                content: '<h2>Welcome!</h2><p>Thanks for joining us.</p>',
            },
        ],
    },
};
```

---

## Component API

```tsx
import { Editor, defaultEditorConfig, sanitizeHtml } from '@erag/text-editor-react';
import type { EditorInit, EditorInstance, EditorProps, EditorEvents, EditorSlots } from '@erag/text-editor-react';
```

### Props (`EditorProps`)
- `value?: string` + `onChange?: (value: string) => void`: controlled HTML content.
- `defaultValue?: string`: uncontrolled initial HTML.
- `init?: EditorInit`: configuration (height, menubar, toolbar, plugins, uploads, mentions, mergeTags, templates, sanitize, ...). Omitted keys keep defaults. Inline objects are fine; changes are detected structurally.
- `disabled?: boolean`, `readOnly?: boolean`.
- `id?: string`, `name?: string` (renders a hidden `<input>` with the HTML for native form posts), `ariaLabel?: string`, `className?: string`.

### Callback props (`EditorEvents`)
- `onChange(value: string)`: every content change.
- `onCommit(value: string)`: on blur when content changed.
- `onClick(MouseEvent)`, `onFocus(FocusEvent)`, `onBlur(FocusEvent)`, `onInput(InputEvent)`, `onKeyDown(KeyboardEvent)`, `onPaste(ClipboardEvent)`.
- `onReady(root: HTMLElement)`, `onSelectionChange(Selection)`, `onResize({ height })`.
- `onMentionSearch(MentionSearchEvent)`, `onMentionSelect(MentionSelectEvent)`, `onMentionRemove(MentionRemoveEvent)`.
- `onMergeTagSelect(MergeTagSelectEvent)`, `onMergeTagRemove(MergeTagRemoveEvent)`.
- `onTemplateInsert(TemplateInsertEvent)`, `onImageRemove(ImageDeleteInfo)`.

### Render props (`EditorSlots`)
- `toolbarStart`, `toolbarEnd`, `menubarEnd`, `statusbarStart`, `statusbarEnd`, `emptyState`: `ReactNode`.
- `renderMentionItem({ item, active })`, `renderMentionLoading({ query })`, `renderMentionEmpty({ query })`, `renderMentionError({ query, retry })`: return `ReactNode`.

### Instance methods (`EditorInstance`, via `useRef<EditorInstance>(null)` + `ref`)
`focus()`, `blur()`, `getHtml()`, `setHtml(value)`, `getText()`, `clear()`, `insertHtml(value)`, `insertText(value)`, `selectAll()`, `undo()`, `redo()`, `openSourceCode()`, `openPreview()`, `getRootElement()`.

### Image upload
```ts
import type { EditorInit, ImagesUploadHandler } from '@erag/text-editor-react';

const upload: ImagesUploadHandler = async (blobInfo, progress) => {
    const body = new FormData();
    body.append('file', blobInfo.blob(), blobInfo.filename());
    const response = await fetch('/uploads', { method: 'POST', body });
    progress(100);
    return (await response.json()).url;
};

const editorConfig: EditorInit = { imagesUploadHandler: upload, pasteImages: true };
```

Security: the built-in browser sanitizer is defense-in-depth only. Always sanitize untrusted HTML again on the server.
